name: Smol Launch

sources.title: Smol Launch homepage — weekly launch board, DR 74
Smol Launch pricing — Free Verified / Premium $19 / Premium+ $39 / Maker Pass / Launch Everywhere

conditions: Free launches require verifying the Smol Launch badge on your site ('Free Verified')
Only 50 verified free slots per week, shared platform-wide — the pricing page showed 'Next free week: Nov 2, 250 ahead of you'
Free tier covers a product's FIRST launch only; relaunches of the same product require a paid tier
requirements: Account/signup required (submission CTAs route to /signup; submit dashboard at /dashboard/products/new)
A site where the Smol Launch badge can be embedded (free path)
Every launch, free or paid, competes in the same weekly (Mon–Sun) public-vote ranking
preparation: Product name, tagline (≤60 chars for newsletter features), description, logo, categories, URL
Badge HTML ready to embed for free verification
Launch-week timing decision — launches run Monday 9:00 AM PDT to Sunday
workflow: Submit the product via the dashboard (/dashboard/products/new)
Choose Free Verified, Premium ($19/launch) or Premium+ ($39/launch)
Free: embed badge → verification → assigned to the next open launch week
Collect votes Monday–Sunday; listing becomes permanent on the DR 74 domain after the week ends
watchFor: Free queue can stretch weeks out — shared 50-slot weekly pool, not a per-maker allowance
Premium+ adds a one-week Featured Spot + newsletter feature; Maker Pass ($99/yr) covers unlimited Premium launches
'Launch Everywhere' ($99–$199) is a separate done-for-you directory-submission add-on, easy to accidentally bundle
Featured Spot ($19/wk) is an ad — marked sponsored and excluded from ranking
Site is markdown-native — every page has a .md twin
countsAsLive: A public product page at smollaunch.com/products/<slug> plus appearance in that week's launch board (e.g. /launches/2026-week-NN).
unknowns: How badge verification is implemented (crawler vs manual check)
